title: CCG Diffusion: Combinatory Categorial Grammar-Driven Compositional and Syntactically Disambiguated Text-to-Image Generation
title_zh: CCG Diffusion：基于组合范畴语法的组合式与句法消歧文生图生成

paragraphs.en: 提出免训练的CCG Diffusion，利用组合范畴语法控制属性绑定、空间关系并解决句法歧义。 Text-to-image generation models do not explicitly receive the syntactic structure of the prompt, i.e., which word modifies which and where each phrase attaches. Consequently, they often struggle to bind attributes to the correct objects, to depict spatial relations and counts correctly, and to render syntactically ambiguous prompts in the intended interpretation. Existing syntax-based control methods mainly address attribute binding and have limited ability to control spatial relations and counts or to specify the interpretation of syntactically ambiguous prompts. They rely on phrase-structure or dependency grammars and require additional rules or constraints on the tree structure to extract modification relations between words or to specify a syntactic interpretation. We propose CCG Diffusion, a training-free method that controls image generation using Combinatory Categorial Grammar (CCG). In CCG, the category of each word carries rich syntactic information: it specifies what the word combines with and what phrase it forms. Modification relations between words can therefore be read directly from a CCG parse. Moreover, prepositional phrase (PP) attachment ambiguity, a representative syntactic ambiguity, can be resolved simply by fixing the preposition's category. CCG Diffusion applies the same two CCG-based mechanisms, prompt rewriting and attention guidance, both to controlling attribute binding, spatial relations, and counts and to resolving PP ambiguity. On two architecturally different backbones, Stable Diffusion and Sana, CCG Diffusion achieves the highest scores among the compared methods in attribute binding and 2D spatial relations and significantly outperforms all of them in PP ambiguity resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 提出免训练的CCG Diffusion，利用组合范畴语法控制属性绑定、空间关系并解决句法歧义。文生图模型并不显式接收提示词的句法结构，即哪个词修饰哪个词、各短语附着于何处。 因此，它们常常难以将属性绑定到正确的对象上、正确描绘空间关系和数量，以及按照预期解释来渲染句法歧义的提示词。 现有基于句法的控制方法主要针对属性绑定，在控制空间关系和数量或指定句法歧义提示词的解释方面能力有限。 这些方法依赖短语结构语法或依存语法，需要对树结构施加额外的规则或约束，才能提取词与词之间的修饰关系或指定句法解释。 我们提出CCG Diffusion，一种利用组合范畴语法（CCG）控制图像生成的免训练方法。 在CCG中，每个词的范畴携带丰富的句法信息：它规定了该词与什么结合、构成什么短语。 因此，词与词之间的修饰关系可以直接从CCG句法分析中读出。 此外，介词短语（PP）附着歧义作为一种代表性的句法歧义，只需固定介词的范畴即可解决。 CCG Diffusion将同样的两种基于CCG的机制——提示词改写与注意力引导——同时应用于控制属性绑定、空间关系和数量，以及解决PP歧义。 在Stable Diffusion和Sana这两个架构不同的骨干模型上，CCG Diffusion在属性绑定和二维空间关系方面取得了对比方法中最高的分数，并在PP歧义解决方面显著优于所有对比方法。
